MMB Tuesday Ride at Monument Preserve

Monument, CO · Mountain bike

MMB Tuesday Ride at Monument Preserve is a mountain bike group ride in Monument, CO. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Mount Herman Trailhead. About 10–12 miles, intermediate to advanced, up tempo.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: intermediate to advanced, up tempo.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the MMB Tuesday Ride at Monument Preserve group ride

An after-work trail ride north of Colorado Springs with moderate technical terrain. The group is upfront that it is not a beginner club. Post-ride hangout at Routes Outfitters. The same group runs a mellower Thursday ride at Black Forest Regional Park.
